title: PruneNAS: Constraint Aware Neural Architecture Search based Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28964v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse tasks, but its high computational cost remains a major barrier. We introduce PruneNAS, a novel framework that integrates structured pruning into NAS to efficiently explore high-performing architectures while leveraging pretrained models. Unlike conventional NAS methods that train each candidate from scratch, PruneNAS generates a candidate pool by pruning pretrained networks at multiple granularity levels and formulates the selection as a global optimization problem using training-free importance metrics. This approach enables rapid evaluation of candidate architectures under strict resource constraints, dramatically reducing search time from hundreds of GPU hours to mere minutes. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that PruneNAS discovers compact, high-accuracy architectures that nearly halve the computational cost (MACs) of prior methods

translated_title: PruneNAS：基于约束感知神经架构搜索的剪枝
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）在多种任务上已取得最先进的性能，但其高昂的计算成本仍然是一个主要障碍。我们提出了PruneNAS，这是一种将结构化剪枝集成到NAS中的新框架，能够在利用预训练模型的同时高效探索高性能架构。与从头训练每个候选架构的传统NAS方法不同，PruneNAS通过在多个粒度级别上对预训练网络进行剪枝来生成候选池，并使用免训练的重要性度量将架构选择表述为一个全局优化问题。这种方法能够在严格的资源约束下快速评估候选架构，将搜索时间从数百个GPU小时大幅缩短至几分钟。在标准基准上的实验表明，PruneNAS能够发现紧凑且高精度的架构，其计算成本（MACs）几乎是先前方法的一半。
tldr: PruneNAS将结构化剪枝与神经架构搜索相结合，利用预训练模型和免训练的重要性度量在严格资源约束下快速搜索架构，将搜索时间从数百GPU小时缩短至几分钟，并发现计算成本近乎减半的高精度紧凑架构。
en_tdlr: PruneNAS integrates structured pruning into neural architecture search by leveraging pretrained models and training-free importance metrics to rapidly explore architectures under strict resource constraints, reducing search time from hundreds of GPU hours to minutes while discovering compact, high-accuracy architectures that nearly halve the computational cost of prior methods.
